notes.title: Projekt: Passion - Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2173800/extras/about3.gif?t=1669327937[/img]

Just like After the Inferno, Projekt: Passion is heavy on story and characterization and is interspersed with animated and voice acted cutscenes to bring the world to life.

Experience a good mix of comedy and drama through a story with dialogue choices that let you mold your own personality. Pursue a romance with your favourite girl (human, alien, android, you name it), or all of them, or none of them if you just want to experience the story. The choice is yours.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2173800/extras/story3.gif?t=1669327937[/img]

Earth has long since been abandoned, and what remains of humanity is now spread out across the galaxy. So what happened at Earth? That part of history has long since been lost to obscurity.

But what do you care? You have your own problems to deal with.

You've just survived an assassination attempt at the cost of your apartment. Sounds like any other day of the week, right? Right, only this time your partner has mysteriously vanished as well, and it's your duty to find out where she went! Word of warning: the answer may lead to... bigger adventures than you'd planned for. Better pack an extra lunch.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2173800/extras/features3.gif?t=1669327937[/img]

- A story set in an original futuristic world.
- High quality animations
- Build your harem with a diverse cast of characters with their own personalities and motivations.
- Lore entries for those interested in the world
- Dialogue options that let you decide your personality

If you enjoyed After the Inferno, you'll definitely enjoy this.

Coming spring 2023. Wishlist now!
[url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2173800/Projekt_Passion__Season_1[/url]
